meta.covers: Growth from spring 2023 to spring 2025 (weighted two-year average), grades 4-8
meta.measure: Average growth score: test-score points above or below students statewide who had similar scores the year before. 0 = typical.
meta.cuts: Minimal: below -20 · Moderate: -20 to -6 · Average: -5 to +4 · Accelerated: +5 to +19 · Exceptional: +20 and up
meta.source: California Department of Education, Growth Model downloadable data file (2025)
meta.note: Level 0 means the state did not assign a level (too few students).
